visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a white plate on a wooden table. On the plate sits a sculptural figure of a coiled snake made from white mashed food, possibly potato or rice puree. The snake has tiny black dots for eyes and a thin red strip of pepper as a tongue. A white mug is visible in the blurred background. (2) A metal ladle enters the frame, pouring a thick, pinkish-red creamy soup onto the plate around the base of the white snake. The soup has small dark flecks throughout. (3) A hand reaches into the frame and places a small, bright green broccoli floret into the pink soup at the front of the snake. The lighting is bright and domestic. (4) The hand uses a small pair of tweezers or fingers to carefully place a single, small dried silver fish into the soup next to the broccoli. The camera zooms in slightly to focus on the completed dish, showing the contrast between the white snake, pink soup, and green vegetables.

The juxtaposition of a meticulously crafted but absurd snake-shaped food garnish with a 'seafood bisque' and nonsensical, fake-French audio creates a humorous and entertaining 'meme' effect.
